summary: To keep fapolicyd enforcing, trust the service account's Ansible temp dir: create `/etc/fapolicy/rules.d/50-ansible.rules` with `allow perm=any uid=ansible trust=1 : dir=/home/ansible/.ansible/tmp/` and restart `fapolicyd.service`; test the rule with your other rules and get auditor approval.
questions: How do I write a fapolicyd rule for Ansible?
Allow Ansible temp directory in fapolicyd
Keep fapolicyd enforcing and still run Ansible

answer_card.title: fapolicyd rule for Ansible
answer_card.answer_md:
```
# /etc/fapolicy/rules.d/50-ansible.rules
allow perm=any uid=ansible trust=1 : dir=/home/ansible/.ansible/tmp/
```
```bash
sudo systemctl restart fapolicyd.service
```
Test it with your existing rules before production.
